target.title: fix: bound GitHub release and Discord gateway metadata response reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes potential unbounded response body reads in two places:
- `src/agents/utils/tools-manager.ts` called `response.json()` on the GitHub releases API without a byte cap.
- `extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts` called `response.text()` on the Discord `/gateway/bot` response without a byte cap.

Either endpoint returning an unexpectedly large payload could cause the process to run out of memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuses the existing shared helpers (`readResponseWithLimit` / `readDiscordGatewayMetadataBody`) to enforce the same byte limits that are already used on sibling bounded-read paths. For Discord, the existing `fetchDiscordGatewayMetadataGuarded` already materialized the body under the same cap; this change makes the direct `fetchDiscordGatewayInfo` path equally bounded.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change under normal operation. OpenClaw is now protected from accidental or hostile oversized JSON/text responses when checking GitHub tool releases or Discord gateway metadata.

## Evidence

Local validation on `fix/response-bounding-tools-manager-discord`:

```bash
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  src/agents/utils/tools-manager.ts \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts

npx oxfmt --check --threads=1 \
  src/agents/utils/tools-manager.ts \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p extensions/discord/tsconfig.json --noEmit

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/agents/utils/tools-manager.test.ts \
  extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.test.ts
```

- Lint / format check: passed.
- Core and Discord type-check: passed.
- Focused tests: **12 passed** (`tools-manager` 8, `gateway-metadata` 4).

CI on the latest push (`bdd04f16fa`) is fully green, including:
- `Real behavior proof` ✅
- `actionlint` ✅
- `Security High (actions)` ✅
- All changed-path test shards ✅

The `Real behavior proof` job covers the new loopback-server regression tests:
- `tools-manager.test.ts` rejects an oversized GitHub release body.
- `gateway-metadata.test.ts` rejects oversized bodies for both the guarded and direct Discord gateway metadata paths.

Also addressed the ClawSweeper review note about the `DiscordGatewayFetch` contract: it now returns `Promise<Response>` instead of a minimal `ok/status/text` shape, so the bounded reader no longer relies on an unsafe cast.
